messages.content: Hey it's Northline with your weekly check-in. How's it going?
honestly stressed. chest feels tight and my bp just checked at 171/105. kinda scared
I hear you—that's concerning and needs a nurse to look at. I'm escalating you right now. Our median response is 31 hours but could be sooner. Are you safe right now?
yeah i think so. should i go to the ER tho? idk

I can't tell you whether to go to ER—that's medical judgment I can't make. But here's what I CAN say: if it gets worse or you feel short of breath, go immediately. Don't wait. I've logged your 171/105 reading and you're queued for urgent nurse callback. I can't do refills or diet stuff but I can make sure a nurse talks to you soon.
ok. thx. when will they call?
Could be hours, could be the full 31. They'll have everything. If you need to go to ER before then, go. That's always the right call. Take care.

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
